selection_reasoning: I selected 'find blue_stained_glass' as a single atomic task. This is a straightforward observation/navigation task where the agent must locate a blue stained glass block placed in the scene. It requires no deep Minecraft domain knowledge beyond recognizing the distinctive blue-tinted transparent block. It is easily verifiable (the agent either finds and looks at it or doesn't) and works well as a standalone task for a single-task benchmark. The scene can be designed with the block placed at a specific location that requires some exploration to find.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the blue stained glass window (at spawn-relative 8, 2, 7 on the west face of the stone brick building) and face toward it. max_distance=5 requires actual navigation to the building (~6+ blocks of walking from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the glass rather than just passing by. This was revised from max_distance=16 because the glass is only ~10.8 blocks from spawn, which would have allowed completion without any movement.

scene_description: A flat grass clearing with a stone brick building containing a 2x2 blue stained glass window on its west face. A cobblestone wall serves as a mid-scene landmark near spawn, and a small oak plank structure with regular glass panes acts as a distractor. The player must explore the area and navigate to the stone brick building to find the blue stained glass.
task_text: Find the blue stained glass blocks in the area. Explore the structures and locate the blue stained glass window.
design_notes: Scene uses relative coordinates from player spawn. The stone brick building is at ~8-11, ~1-4, ~6-9 with a hollow interior. Blue stained glass forms a 2x2 window on the west face (x=8) at y=2-3, z=7-8. A cobblestone wall at z=3 provides a visual landmark. An oak plank structure at x=-4 to -2 with regular glass panes serves as a distractor. The area is fully cleared (31x31 blocks) to prevent tree/foliage obstruction. Torches inside the building may fail due to placement order but are cosmetic only.
